install_destination_concept: After closeout approval only, DollyOps copies the four code-hash-pinned immutable overlay files to <resolved DollyArchitect HERMES_HOME>/runtime_policy/dollyarchitect and adds the exact profile-local agent.runtime_policy activation mapping; shared skills remain untouched.
install_actions: verify a Hermes-created candidate commit and tree after closeout
review the candidate package and scoped verification receipts
have DollyOps copy the four reviewed immutable files into the fixed profile-local overlay
have DollyOps add the exact two-field agent.runtime_policy activation mapping and required model/agent/Telegram invariants
run profile-load, schema, rejected-dispatch, and accepted no-side-effect smoke checks before scheduling a real card
rollback_actions: set agent.runtime_policy.enabled to false or remove the exact mapping before overlay removal
verify the policy no longer loads, then remove only runtime_policy/dollyarchitect
restore the prior profile-local overlay snapshot if one existed
rerun profile load and no-live-mutation checks
live_no_mutation_boundary: a local candidate commit is permitted for provenance and does not install or activate the candidate
no live profile or shared skill changes
no live profile activation, gateway/notifier mutation, or Kanban schema change
no credentials, provider, model, auth, service, product-chain, or telemetry mutation
no remote or public push, pull request, release, or deploy
post_closeout_sequence: Hermes creates and records the exact candidate commit and tree
independent review validates the closed candidate
DollyOps performs any approved profile-local install and explicit config activation
DollyOps runs the documented activation smoke checks
